title: Historical aggTrade order-flow email signal engine
purpose: Test whether causal Binance USD-M public historical aggTrades add enough actionable order-flow information to produce a cost-adjusted email signal engine. This experiment does not alter HY-EXP-0039 or reuse its result for tuning.

HY-EXP-0039.role: Historical/reference evidence only; no parameter, feature, threshold, or outcome tuning.

conformanceRule: HY-EXP-0040 may add only the preregistered causal public aggTrade order-flow data and the single preregistered logistic model. All candidate, reference-trade, cost, walk-forward, frequency, and promotion semantics are frozen before outcome read.

dataPolicy.primarySource: Binance official public USD-M Futures aggTrades archive
archivePatterns: daily/aggTrades/<SYMBOL>/<SYMBOL>-aggTrades-YYYY-MM-DD.zip only for a proven monthly gap
dataPolicy.backfillMeaning: Registered historical archive acquisition is permitted only for the preregistered 2024-08-26 through 2026-08-26 window; no current or future data may fill a gap.

storage.preference: monthly first, daily only for a verified monthly gap
storage.rawRetention: Do not permanently retain the full decompressed raw archive; stream parse after checksum verification and remove only temporary raw ZIP/CSV after all derived evidence is written and hashed.

dataPolicy.qualityFailure: Any missing, unavailable, checksum-mismatched, malformed, duplicate, out-of-order, non-contiguous, out-of-window, or causally unproven source rejects the affected source and prevents a PASS. No silent repair.

aggTradeSchema.ordering: Strict timestamp ordering within each symbol and source partition; duplicate aggregate trade identity or timestamp ambiguity is invalid.
aggTradeSchema.gapPolicy: Known archive partition boundaries are checked against the official coverage calendar; an unexplained missing interval is DATA_FAIL and is never filled.

causalAggregation.availability: Only trades with trade timestamp strictly before the completed 1m bucket close may enter that bucket; a feature at decisionTime may use only completed buckets with bucket closeTime less than or equal to decisionTime.
causalAggregation.CVD: Cumulative signedNotional from the first valid source observation, never using future trades.
causalAggregation.missingWindowHandling: Missing 1m buckets remain missing and invalidate any dependent candidate; no forward-fill, interpolation, zero-fill, or synthetic trade.

largeTrade.threshold: Per-symbol P95 quoteNotional of the immediately prior completed 24h aggTrade distribution.
largeTrade.first24h: large-trade features unavailable until a complete prior 24h distribution exists.
largeTrade.availability: The threshold at decisionTime is calculated only from trades in completed buckets ending no later than decisionTime and strictly within the prior 24h window.

orderFlowPrimary.priceImpactProxy: Causal return divided by signedNotional with deterministic zero handling.

features.invalidHandling: Missing, late, non-finite, non-PIT, or incomplete dependency invalidates the candidate; no feature imputation.

universe.symbolChangePolicy: No symbol may be added, removed, or rescued after outcome read.

candidateGenerator.name: BROAD_BIDIRECTIONAL_15M_CAUSAL_AGGTRADE_CANDIDATES
candidateGenerator.emission: For every complete fixed symbol and eligible completed 15m decision emit exactly one independent BUY and one independent SELL raw candidate.
candidateGenerator.regime: BULL, BEAR, and SIDEWAYS are context/features only; regime never suppresses a candidate.
candidateGenerator.sidewaysAction: Retain SIDEWAYS context and emit both sides.
candidateGenerator.requiredInvariant: BUY count equals SELL count for every symbol and eligible decision; coverageRatio must equal 1.0, medianDecisionGapMs must equal 900000, and unexpectedGap must equal 0.

referenceTrade.entry: First exact contract-price 5m OPEN at or after decisionTime; no later rescue and no historical fill substitution.
referenceTrade.atr: ATR20 from completed 1h contract-price bars available no later than decisionTime
referenceTrade.terminalRule: At the bar whose openTime equals entryTime plus 12 hours, execute MAX_HOLD at bar open before reading high or low.
referenceTrade.overlap: Same-symbol active reference trade suppresses a new candidate; early exit releases the symbol for a later decision.
referenceTrade.funding: Apply realized funding events strictly inside entryTime < fundingTime < exitTime using actual side and mark price.

costs.charge: One frozen all-in execution cost budget per entry and exit fill; source-embedded costs are not charged twice.

model.name: REGULARIZED_LOGISTIC_EDGE_MODEL
model.scaling: Training-fold only mean/std; no validation or OOF scaling and no feature clipping.

walkForward.method: Expanding purged walk-forward with independent complete OOF by lambda

frequency.sameDecisionConflict: If BUY and SELL for the same symbol and decision both qualify, retain only the higher predicted edge with a deterministic tie-break.
frequency.crossSymbolRanking: Rank eligible candidates by predicted edge at the decision boundary.

developmentSelection.grid: For each lambda, empirical predicted-edge percentiles 90.0 through 99.9 inclusive at step 0.1.
